en.text:
Reloading randomly overfills the Magazine from reserves by <enhanced/>${10*#d}% to 50% of the base Magazine Capacity (rounded up).

Works out to a <enhanced/>${30*#f}% overfill on average.

enhanced (
var d = 1.3
var f = 1.05
<enhanced/> Increases the minimum overfill amount by 30%. (10%⁠<arrow/>⁠13%)
)
